# onetsolutions_dns_zone_dnssec (Resource)

Manages the DNSSEC signing of a DNS zone.

Enabling it signs the zone and returns the DS record to publish at the domain's registrar (done
automatically for a domain registered through OnetSolutions, see `automatic_ds_publication`);
`status` stays `pending` until the registrar publishes it.

~> **Warning.** Before disabling DNSSEC — setting `enabled = false` or destroying this resource —
remove the DS record from the domain's registrar and wait for its TTL to expire. A domain whose
registrar still publishes a DS record for a zone that is no longer signed **stops resolving**.
When `automatic_ds_publication` is true, OnetSolutions publishes the DS record at the registrar
for you. Every plan that disables DNSSEC repeats this warning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onetsolutions_dns_zone" "example" {
  zone_name = "example.com"
}

resource "onetsolutions_dns_zone_dnssec" "example" {
  zone_id = onetsolutions_dns_zone.example.id
  enabled = true
}

# Publish this DS record at the registrar, unless automatic_ds_publication is true.
output "example_ds_record" {
  value = onetsolutions_dns_zone_dnssec.example.ds_record
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the zone is signed. Read the warning above before setting it to `false`.
- `zone_id` (String) The UUID of the zone (see `onetsolutions_dns_zone`). Changing it recreates the resource.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id` when the object is created; changing it explicitly recreates the object.
- `project_id` (String) The project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id` when the object is created; changing it explicitly recreates the object.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) The DNSSEC algorithm number of the key.
- `automatic_ds_publication` (Boolean) Whether the DS record is published at the registrar automatically.
- `digest` (String) The digest of the DS record.
- `digest_type` (String) The digest type of the DS record.
- `ds_record` (String) The DS record to publish at the registrar, in zone-file form.
- `flags` (Number) The flags of the DNSKEY record.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the zone, the identifier of its DNSSEC state.
- `key_tag` (Number) The key tag of the DS record.
- `public_key` (String) The DNSKEY public key, for registrars that ask for it instead of a DS record.
- `status` (String) `active`, `pending` (signed, waiting for the DS record at the registrar), `disabled`, `pending_disabled` or `error`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = onetsolutions_dns_zone_dnssec.example
  id = "3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b/8b1d4e2f-6c3a-4f9e-8d7b-2a1c0e9f8d7c/5e7c2a1b-9d3f-4a6e-8b2c-1d0f9e8a7b6c"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<project_id>/<zone_id>, or <zone_id> when the provider sets organization_id and project_id.
terraform import onetsolutions_dns_zone_dnssec.example 3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b/8b1d4e2f-6c3a-4f9e-8d7b-2a1c0e9f8d7c/5e7c2a1b-9d3f-4a6e-8b2c-1d0f9e8a7b6c
```
